Gain 3, Work 1, Harm 2
Raise: Not done — When the default stop choice narrows a fix after 30 minutes, this call reaches `apply_review_choice`, which returns without changing a plan for fixes (`src/forge/task.py:88`). The resulting message (`src/forge/close.py:525`) names only the follow-up fixes and a command to reverse the choice; it never names `forge fix amend` as the required next step. The fix amend proof test covers only an explicit `--resolve narrow` choice, so it would pass with this normal default-choice path broken.
